entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-30
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • HTTP/3 Client migration behind LB #68118
  • [API Proposal]: Device Bound Session Credentials (DBSC) for cookie authentication #68117
  • Harden CacheTagHelper vary-by-user: cache key can collide for distinct authenticated principals without a stable Identity.Name #68112
  • Serve the well-known passkey endpoints document in Identity #68109
  • ApiExplorer loses top-level BinderModelName when expanding complex query parameters #68106
  • TestHost: exception during ReturnResponseMessageAsync's feature-collection copy orphans the response TCS — client awaits forever, cancellation cannot break it #68105
  • Fix h3 connection-level and stream-level abort locking #68101
  • Blazor time to first UI regression: blazorwasmbenchmark #68100
  • Virtualize: InitialItemIndex is intermittently ignored on fresh page load (startup race with spacer IntersectionObserver callback) #68099
    11.0-rc1

Closed

  • Blazor wasm publish: MSB4018 ApplyCompressionNegotiation #67842
    Backlog
  • Support async validation in MVC #68104

PullRequests

Created

  • Emit framework versions from Blazor WASM benchmark Driver #68119
    enhancement
  • Dev/snemeckayova/openapi nullability #68116
  • Fix `InitialItemIndex` is intermittently ignored on fresh page load #68114
    area-blazor, feature-blazor-virtualization, 11.0-rc1
  • Fix trim/AOT safety for custom event argument deserialization in Blazor #68113
    community-contribution
  • Fix Flaky HTTP/3 Test: `POST_ClientCancellationUpload_RequestAbortRaised` #68111
    community-contribution
  • Stabilize `CachedResponseBodyTests.Copy_SingleSegment` #68110
    community-contribution
  • Harden RefreshSignInCoreAsync to revalidate cookie always #68103
  • Fix h3 connection-level and stream-level abort locking #68102

Merged

  • Add SignalR TypeScript auth refresh #67964
    area-signalr, feature-client-javascript, 11.0-rc1
  • Fix cursor landing in `InputDateInteractsWithEditContext_TimeInput` #68115
  • Only fail Dependencies.props CodeCheck for non-Maestro dependency changes #68097
  • Fix `InputDateInteractsWithEditContext_NonNullableDateTime` and `InputDateInteractsWithEditContext_NullableDateTimeOffset` #68107
    area-blazor, 11.0-rc1
  • Device Bound Session Credentials (DBSC) for cookie authentication (prototype) #67388
    11.0-preview7

Updated

  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #68120
  • Fix SignalR reconnect identity bypass with EnableAuthenticationRefresh #68008
    area-signalr
  • Move to Roslyn's unified ExternalAccess library #68014
  • [Experimental] DirectTls transport implementation #67912
    area-networking
  • Harden SocialSample FailureMessage rendering and add READMEs into samples #67995
  • Prevent ValidationsGenerator from emitting open generic type references #65419
    community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun, area-minimal, feature-validation
  • Fix  InitialItemIndex viewport underfill for small items in big container #67936
    area-blazor, feature-blazor-virtualization, 11.0-rc1
  • Stabilize `VirtualizationTest.CancelsOutdatedRefreshes_Async` flaky test #68079
    area-blazor, feature-blazor-virtualization, 11.0-rc1
  • Update SDK to latest main build #68086
  • [Blazor] Components.AI - full library (supersedes #66181-#66187) #67673
  • Fix validation for null nullable parameters in minimal APIs #67395
    community-contribution, pr: pending author input, area-minimal, feature-validation
  • Add serving of .well-known/passkey-endpoints to Identity #68066
    area-identity
  • Support validating dictionary values in Microsoft.Extensions.Validation #67818
  • [release/11.0-preview7] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #68077
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:
  • Fix double-publish compression error in TestContentPackage #68085
    area-infrastructure, area-blazor
  • SignInManager: return SignInResult.Failed for expired passkey session challenge #67539
    area-identity, community-contribution
  • Add SkipStatusCodePages property to ApiBehaviorOptions #68098
    community-contribution
  • Replace `WebEncoders.Base64UrlDecode` with `Base64Url.Decode` in Antiforgery #68035
    area-mvc, community-contribution, feature-antiforgery
  • Fix draggable Attribute Rendering for Blazor Elements #67970
    community-contribution
